I wanted to write a review to share my experience with Tru Solar. I just had a 6 kw system installed. From the beginning, the sales person Vincent was impressive. He was knowledgeable and informative  about what system i could get, and the  process involved. After a $300 deposit, the process was fast and smooth. I was contacted by Shane from installation team, who organised a date for my install. What impressed me was both Vincent and Shane were available at any time on a direct  number they provided to answer any questions I had, straight through with no wait! The install team were a local business, SA Electrics and Data. They were professional and thorough, fantastic job guys! The entire process took 6 weeks, and my 6kw solar system is up and running! I really am impressed, and a little surprised to be honest, with how professional and reliable the entire process was. I give a 5 star rating for customer service and installation, and would not hesitate to recommend these people to anyone who is unsure of where to go.
